# Vipin Garg

> Live online exam preparation for Canadian finance professionals. Classes are taught live by Vipin Garg. Courses cover securities (CIRO / CSI), life insurance licensing (LLQP) and financial planning exams.
> # PLACEHOLDER: confirm business description, legal name and years teaching with the client

Not affiliated with CSI or CIRO. CSI, CSC, IFC and related marks belong to their owners.

## Who teaches
- Vipin Garg: instructor and founder. https://vipingarg.com/about

## Courses
Securities (https://vipingarg.com/securities)
